phrase.zh: 接触的轻重，也是一种信息。
phrase.en: The pressure of touch is information.

visual.zh: 机械手旁的弧线和细小接触点，把抓取过程画成视觉与触觉的协作。它不表示机器人具备人类的感觉体验。
visual.en: A robotic hand, arcs and tiny contact points connect vision with touch during grasping. They do not imply a robot experiences touch as a person does.

background.zh: 机器人抓取需要判断物体位置、接触与施力情况。美国国家标准与技术研究院正在研究触觉传感和抓取评测方法，目的是更可靠地测量和比较机器人操作能力。
background.en: Robotic grasping involves object position, contact and applied force. NIST studies tactile sensing and grasping test methods to measure and compare manipulation performance more reliably.
